title: Four Clues on شارع الياسمين (أربع أدلة بشارع الياسمين)

scenes.title: Twenty Paces East
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Jasmine Street, Nour, Rami, and Tariq check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: By the Stone Fountain
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, Nour and Tariq spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Rami insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: The Famous Shortcut
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Rami leads the group straight back outside Salma's open café kitchen window at Jasmine Courtyard House.

scenes.title: Shadow of the Clock Tower
scenes.summary: Joined by Ziad at the municipal clock tower at noon, Nour and Tariq watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Under the Bookshop Arch
scenes.summary: Meeting Suad under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Nour spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making Suad gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: The Shaded Park Bench
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Jasmine Street, Tariq places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Jasmine Courtyard House with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Opening the Small Envelope
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Nour, Suad, and Tariq break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Message at the Front Desk
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Nour and Rami find Mazen holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
